newsitem.title: USA: Outboard continues boat group realignment.
newsitem.headline: Outboard continues boat group realignment.

text.p: Outboard Marine Corp said Tuesday it took another step in the strategic realignment of its boat group by appointing three senior executives as functional division heads reporting to Clark Vitulli, who was named group president in 1996.

The new OMC Boat Group organization consolidates the operations of six boat groups and their associated brands: Chris Craft, Four Winns, Seaswirl, Sunbird, the Aluminum Boat Group and the Fishing Boat Group.
Rick Reyenger was named vice president-sales for all boat brands; Paula Rummage, vice president-finance for the group and Rick Fulmer, vice president-marketing and communications.
